courses.overview: 從MPPT、直流鏈與三相併網控制延伸至相近領域；相似物理不代表同一設備規格或驗收程序。
courses.overviewEn: Extend mppt, dc links and three-phase interconnection control to neighboring domains; shared physics does not imply identical equipment requirements or acceptance procedures.

related.title: 晶矽太陽電池模組製造
related.why: IV 曲線提供 MPPT 工作點
related.whyEn: IV curves supply MPPT operating points
related.transfer: IV 曲線提供 MPPT 工作點
related.transferEn: IV curves supply MPPT operating points
related.difference: 逆變器不會消除電池本體損失
related.differenceEn: Inverters do not remove intrinsic cell loss
practice: 以「串列電壓」為起點，畫出本課與「晶矽太陽電池模組製造」可共用及須重畫的系統邊界。
針對「逆變器不會消除電池本體損失」各選一項能區分兩課的量測。
將本課算例移植到新情境：保留方程依據，重新指定單位、材料或拓撲，並標示無法沿用的數值。
practiceEn: Start from string voltage and mark shared/redefined boundaries with crystalline-silicon solar-module manufacturing.
For the difference "Inverters do not remove intrinsic cell loss", choose discriminating measurements for both courses.
Transfer the worked example: retain justified equations, respecify units, materials or topology and identify values that cannot transfer.
